evidence: Carries the Validation label, modifies block index loading in src/node/blockstorage.cpp and candidate population in src/validation.cpp, and fixes assumeutxo sync behavior.
rationale: Fixes a repeatable startup assertion failure in FindMostWorkChain() that puts the node into an unbootable state during assumeutxo background validation. As detailed in the description, restarting after receiving the snapshot block out-of-order crashes validation on every boot, leaving the user unable to recover without -reindex or -reindex-chainstate which completely wipes the snapshot chainstate.
